2027-05-02.title: Sixth Sunday of Resurrection
2027-05-02.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: How beautiful are the feet of the messenger
That they may all be one
2027-05-02.verse: that they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.

2027-05-06.title: The Ascension of our Lord
2027-05-06.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Elijah is taken up to heaven
As they were watching, he was lifted up
One mediator between God and humankind
He withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven
2027-05-06.verse: While he was blessing them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

2027-05-09.title: Seventh Sunday of Resurrection (the Sunday after the Ascension)
2027-05-09.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Matthias is added to the eleven apostles
Every tongue shall confess that Jesus Christ is Lord
Go into all the world and proclaim the good news
2027-05-09.verse: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” And I said, “Here am I; send me!”

2027-05-16.title: First Sunday of the Apostles · The Feast of Pentecost
2027-05-16.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: A priestly kingdom and a holy nation
The Holy Spirit comes down on the apostles
Varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit
The Spirit of truth will guide you into all the truth
2027-05-16.verse: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages, as the Spirit gave them ability.

2027-05-23.title: Second Sunday of the Apostles · Feast of the Most Holy Trinity
2027-05-23.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: I am your God, who teaches and leads you
God's love poured out through the Holy Spirit
The Spirit of truth will guide you
2027-05-23.verse: And hope does not disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit that has been given to us.

2027-05-30.title: Third Sunday of the Apostles
2027-05-30.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: You have stayed long enough at this mountain
A people who went astray from God
2027-05-30.verse: He said, “The one who showed him mercy.” Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

2027-05-01.title: Fifth Saturday of Resurrection · St Joseph, Patron of the Working Class
2027-05-01.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: By the sweat of your face you shall eat bread
Send wisdom to labour at my side
Do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus
Is not this the carpenter's son?
2027-05-01.verse: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

2027-05-03.title: Sixth Monday of Resurrection · Sts Philip and James, Apostles
2027-05-03.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: I will sing to the Lord, for he has triumphed gloriously
The righteous will stand with great confidence
Woe to me if I do not proclaim the gospel
I am the way, and the truth, and the life
2027-05-03.verse: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.”

2027-05-04.title: Sixth Tuesday of Resurrection
2027-05-04.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: New heavens and a new earth
2027-05-04.verse: Beware, keep alert; for you do not know when the time will come.

2027-05-05.title: Sixth Wednesday of Resurrection
2027-05-05.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Be imitators of God, as beloved children
2027-05-05.verse: “This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.”

2027-05-07.title: Sixth Friday of Resurrection · First Friday
2027-05-07.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The one who comes from above is above all
2027-05-07.verse: He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for he gives the Spirit without measure.

2027-05-08.title: Sixth Saturday of Resurrection
2027-05-08.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire
2027-05-08.verse: I baptize you with water for repentance, but one who is more powerful than I is coming after me; I am not worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

2027-05-10.title: Seventh Monday of Resurrection
2027-05-10.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: God chose you as the first fruits for salvation
2027-05-10.verse: The water that I will give will become in them a spring of water gushing up to eternal life.

2027-05-11.title: Seventh Tuesday of Resurrection
2027-05-11.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Do not become a stumbling block to the weak
The parable of the rich fool
2027-05-11.verse: So it is with those who store up treasures for themselves but are not rich toward God.

2027-05-12.title: Seventh Wednesday of Resurrection
2027-05-12.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: God is love; he has given us of his Spirit
This is eternal life: that they may know you
2027-05-12.verse: And this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.

2027-05-13.title: Seventh Thursday of Resurrection
2027-05-13.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: We declare to you the word of life
2027-05-13.verse: Whoever does not carry the cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

2027-05-14.title: Seventh Friday of Resurrection · St Matthias, Apostle (Mar Mathias Shleeha)
2027-05-14.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The LORD looks on the heart: David is anointed
Matthias is added to the eleven apostles
God chose what is weak in the world
Revealed to infants; come to me and find rest
2027-05-14.verse: And they cast lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was added to the eleven apostles.

2027-05-15.title: Seventh Saturday of Resurrection · Blessed Virgin Mary, Protectress of Harvest
2027-05-15.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: You shall observe the festival of harvest
The threshing floors shall be full of grain; I will pour out my spirit
The gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable
Not one of these little ones should be lost
2027-05-15.verse: The threshing floors shall be full of grain, the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.

2027-05-17.title: First Monday of the Apostles · Mary, Mother of the Church
2027-05-17.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Let all things be done for building up
Learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart
2027-05-17.verse: for God is a God not of disorder but of peace.

2027-05-18.title: First Tuesday of the Apostles
2027-05-18.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Worthy of the kingdom for which you suffer
Lord, let our eyes be opened
2027-05-18.verse: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes. Immediately they regained their sight and followed him.

2027-05-19.title: First Wednesday of the Apostles
2027-05-19.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: When you come together to eat, wait for one another
The mustard seed and the yeast
2027-05-19.verse: The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that someone took and sowed in his field;

2027-05-20.title: First Thursday of the Apostles
2027-05-20.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The new covenant inscribed in the heart
2027-05-20.verse: Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

2027-05-21.title: First Friday of the Apostles · The Friday of Gold
2027-05-21.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: A lame man is healed by the apostles
The blind see and the lame walk
2027-05-21.verse: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have I give you; in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, stand up and walk.”

2027-05-22.title: First Saturday of the Apostles
2027-05-22.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: We are one body in the Spirit
Believe in the one whom he has sent
2027-05-22.verse: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

2027-05-24.title: Second Monday of the Apostles
2027-05-24.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Hold true to what you have attained
Jesus, the Resurrection and the Life
2027-05-24.verse: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Those who believe in me, even though they die, will live,”

2027-05-25.title: Second Tuesday of the Apostles
2027-05-25.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: You have the words of eternal life
2027-05-25.verse: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom can we go? You have the words of eternal life.”

2027-05-26.title: Second Wednesday of the Apostles
2027-05-26.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
Anyone who comes to me I will never drive away
2027-05-26.verse: Everything that the Father gives me will come to me, and anyone who comes to me I will never drive away;

2027-05-27.title: Second Thursday of the Apostles: the Feast of the Body and Blood of Christ
2027-05-27.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Melchizedek brings out bread and wine
A pure offering in every place
This is my body that is for you
My flesh is true food and my blood is true drink
2027-05-27.verse: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats of this bread will live forever; and the bread that I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.

2027-05-28.title: Second Friday of the Apostles
2027-05-28.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The wisdom of this world is foolishness with God
I am the bread of life
2027-05-28.verse: Very truly, I tell you, whoever believes has eternal life. I am the bread of life.

2027-05-29.title: Second Saturday of the Apostles
2027-05-29.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: Sharing in the Body of Christ
2027-05-29.verse: Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one bread.

2027-05-31.title: Third Monday of the Apostles · The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
2027-05-31.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
2027-05-31.verse: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.

kidsaint: St Peter and St John at the Beautiful Gate
